name: When should I get a roof life expectancy assessment?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a roof life expectancy assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a roof life expectancy assessment if your roof is nearing its manufacturer's estimated lifespan, after a significant storm, before buying or selling a home, or if you notice any visible signs of wear like missing shingles or leaks. A key preparation step is to gather any original roofing documentation, such as installation dates or warranty information, as this can provide valuable context for our assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an assessment if your roof is old, after a storm, before buying/selling, or if you see wear.
